scope: Three series AA cells. Lithium rows conditionally mean primary 1.5 V Li/FeS2. Static source-resistance sensitivity only, not a discharge/runtime or electrochemical model.
notes: E91 lists fresh nominal IR 0.15-0.30 ohm per cell; L91 typical IR 0.12-0.24 ohm per cell depends on method. These are not guaranteed dynamic Thevenin resistances or lifetime bounds.
Holder/wire 0.10 ohm, all pack voltages, and aged/cold resistance values are proposed test points. Measure the fitted pack at load duration and temperature of interest.
Lithium 5.5 V and alkaline 4.8 V are fresh-pack screening points, not guaranteed chemistry maxima. Confirm the actual selected cells and holder.
Q1 resistance and conversion efficiencies are inherited from operating-envelope.json and remain assumptions.
E91 operating temperature is -18 to 55 C; L91 -40 to 60 C. Battery self-heating and nearby electronics matter in an enclosure; these are not PCB limits.
Static no-solution results identify a source-model limitation; do not present them as measured battery failure or a measured runtime.
